name: Sentora mWIN Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDmWIN is Sentora's PYUSD vault lending against mWIN on Morpho; interest accrues to shares, with withdrawals limited by liquidity.
collateral: PYUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied through a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a mWIN-collateralized lending market. Sentora describes mWIN as tokenized Wellington-managed structured credit, including bonds, CLOs and asset-backed credit. Those assets are borrower collateral, not directly owned reserves of the vault-share holder. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to PYUSD at the current assets-per-share rate. Interest, fees and recognized losses change share value. At Ethereum block 26197000, liquidityAdapter() was zero, so ordinary cash redemptions used idle PYUSD unless assets were first deallocated. Permissionless forceDeallocate carries a 1% penalty on deallocated assets; an in-kind lending-position exit is not guaranteed cash redemption. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact holder instrument ethereum:0x7cbcfc4f64be199ede6db1d916ddcdb69f666b57 is an immutable ERC-4626 operational claim on idle PYUSD plus Morpho lender positions, not a direct fiat reserve claim. Deposit/mint transfers underlying assets before issuing shares; accrual can issue fee shares. At Ethereum block 26197000 (hash 0x7f8f6377ac8f3948e1ac61d81c1a236b58c7ef57ef2743f18189cca1127aa66d; 2026-10-15T09:24:59Z), asset() was PYUSD, share decimals 18 and underlying decimals 6; totalAssets raw 12701894517329, totalSupply raw 12671472046590045530313548, idle raw 3109139525532 and sole adapter realAssets raw 9592754991797 reconciled exactly. The only funded market lent PYUSD against mWIN at 77% LLTV; the adapter position had zero borrowShares and posted collateral. convertToAssets(1e18) returned 1002399 raw PYUSD. Morpho vaultV2ByAddress independently retrieved on 2026-10-15 identifies creationBlockNumber 25654512 and creationTimestamp 1785521015 (2026-07-31T18:03:35Z).
